text: {"features":[{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant to Google's Information Security Engineering mission, responsibilities, and scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Names the role or security generally but shows little understanding of this team's specific work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References one broad job theme such as secure development or automation, but the case remains mostly generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the letter to one or two concrete responsibilities from the posting, such as developer enablement, vulnerability handling, or backend tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Aligns multiple parts of the applicant's background with several stated responsibilities, showing clear attention to the posting."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Tightly maps the applicant's experience to the team's mission and responsibilities at Google's scale, including specific themes like agents, triage, variant analysis, or secure-by-default development."}]},{"name":"Career motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why this role is the applicant's deliberate next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the job in generic terms without explaining why it fits the applicant's path."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a basic reason for applying, but the motivation feels thin or interchangeable with many roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a clear and plausible reason this type of security engineering work appeals to the applicant."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links prior experiences or turning points to a well-grounded desire to do this work next."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the move into this specific role feel highly intentional and like a natural continuation of the applicant's trajectory."}]},{"name":"Security engineering perspective","description":"How thoughtfully the letter frames security as an engineering discipline focused on prevention, enablement, rigor, and attacker-aware design.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security as a label or requirement rather than as an engineering discipline with a clear point of view."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in security or reliability but offers little deeper reasoning about how security work should be done."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows one concrete, thoughtful idea about security, such as attacker mindset, prevention, or developer defaults."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a mature view of security as scalable engineering work centered on rigor, enablement, or quiet resilience."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Offers a nuanced and memorable security philosophy that strongly matches automation-first, secure-by-default work in large engineering organizations."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter turns background, motivation, and evidence into a unified story for this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads mainly as a checklist of credentials and claims with little connective thread."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a visible structure but the transitions are abrupt and the main story of fit remains weak."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a clear basic arc from background to motivation to relevant experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maintains a consistent theme that links the opening, examples, and stated interest in the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a cohesive narrative in which the opening idea, evidence, and closing pitch reinforce a single compelling story of fit."}]},{"name":"Formal education level","description":"The level of relevant academic preparation in computer science or a related technical field that the letter presents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions only the minimum relevant bachelor's degree and gains little added force from formal education."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a relevant bachelor's degree as a clear baseline qualification for the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses a relevant bachelor's degree to suggest stronger-than-minimum technical grounding through how the education is framed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a relevant master's degree, clearly exceeding the baseline requirement."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"States a relevant doctoral degree, signaling the strongest formal academic preparation seen in this sample."}]},{"name":"Production software track record","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant has professionally tested, maintained, and launched real software services over time.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little production scope or only barely establishes experience testing, maintaining, or launching software."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Meets the baseline with modest scope, such as a few years of experience and limited service ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid early-career production experience with multiple launched or maintained services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial scope through broader ownership, more services, or materially longer experience."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production engineering experience, typically with repeated maintenance and launch responsibility across many services over several years."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical, relevant experience building with Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or leaves its level of use unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Lists Go among several languages but gives little evidence of meaningful depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is used regularly in professional work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Positions Go as a primary or most-used production language."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, role-relevant Go experience through primary ownership of backend or infrastructure systems built in Go."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical, relevant experience building with Python.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it only in passing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims Python familiarity without saying what it is used for."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for tooling, services, automation, or analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive Python ownership across production services and internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as production-grade and central to reliable automation, analysis, or agent development."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"The depth of hands-on experience the letter shows with shipping and operating AI or LLM-based functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of hands-on AI or LLM work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals interest in AI or mentions it vaguely without shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on work building or shipping model-backed functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practical production experience with AI, including evaluation, predictability, or failure-mode awareness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong, role-relevant AI experience focused on deploying trustworthy model-based systems under real constraints."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"The depth of experience the letter shows designing agentic tools or autonomous workflows with explicit controls.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no experience with agents or autonomous multi-step workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation loosely without describing how the systems worked."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience designing agentic tools or pipelines."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains concrete architecture, such as Python agents paired with Go services or explicit control boundaries."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic systems with clear attention to autonomy, guardrails, supervision, logging, or auditability."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant has automated vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability triage or response automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation broadly but not concrete vulnerability-handling workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Claims some involvement in automating vulnerability handling with limited detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes tooling that classifies, routes, deduplicates, or prioritizes vulnerability reports."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows direct ownership of a vulnerability-response pipeline that materially turned manual triage into a scalable, mostly self-serve process."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"The depth of hands-on experience the letter shows performing security reviews, threat modeling, or similar assessments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no concrete evidence of security review or assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies security awareness but does not describe actual assessment tasks."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States general experience with security reviews or assessments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies concrete assessment methods such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or fix validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, hands-on assessment work with strong builder or attacker framing across real services or systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of data structures or algorithms ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Asserts algorithmic strength but without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of improving a system through a better algorithm or structure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical algorithmic reasoning that materially improved performance, tractability, or correctness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithms as a clear strength through specific, technically convincing, high-leverage examples."}]},{"name":"Infrastructure systems depth","description":"How much the letter shows the applicant tackling nontrivial backend, distributed, or reliability-sensitive systems problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little technical depth beyond ordinary feature or service work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions backend or infrastructure interest but offers few hard systems problems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one substantive example of nontrivial backend or systems work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates meaningful depth in distributed systems, indexing, scheduling, failure recovery, or other reliability-sensitive design problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated engagement with difficult systems problems, often through ambitious distributed or fault-tolerant work that signals unusual engineering depth."}]},{"name":"Offensive security engagement","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant actively practices attacker-oriented security skills.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no attacker-oriented practice outside general defensive work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security hobby interest without evidence of sustained practice or results."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Cites periodic capture-the-flag participation or similar attacker-focused practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows serious offensive engagement through strong CTF performance or a hands-on security certification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates standout attacker-oriented credibility through near-top competitive results, OSCP-level rigor, or both."}]},{"name":"Open source contribution","description":"How much the letter shows the applicant contributing to or maintaining publicly shared software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of open-source contribution."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions open source only in passing or implies isolated, low-detail contribution."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes occasional upstream patches or small public contributions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained public contribution or maintenance responsibility for a project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates notable open-source leadership by maintaining an actively used project and managing reviews or releases."}]},{"name":"Security credential strength","description":"The strength of formal security credentialing presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists no formal security credential."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows structured security learning but no recognized credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Lists a baseline credential that signals security fundamentals, such as Security+."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents formal credentialing as a meaningful reinforcement of an already credible security profile."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Lists a demanding hands-on credential such as OSCP that strongly signals applied offensive capability."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter supports claims with concrete examples, scope, mechanisms, or project details.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics, but many major claims remain vague or generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Regularly supports claims with examples, counts, or project descriptions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides concrete, role-relevant evidence for most major claims, often including mechanism, scope, or constraints."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Substantiates nearly every important claim with crisp, credible technical detail."}]},{"name":"Impact articulation","description":"How clearly the letter explains the outcomes and leverage of the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes tasks or tools without explaining what they changed."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at usefulness but gives little sense of outcome or leverage."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States clear practical effects such as faster systems, reduced toil, or easier workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly links work to meaningful outcomes for engineers, security teams, or system reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames achievements in high-leverage terms, showing how the work returned expert capacity, scaled judgment, or changed how the team operated."}]},{"name":"Value proposition clarity","description":"How clearly the letter distills the applicant into a compelling, differentiated reason to interview them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Leaves no clear reason to interview the candidate beyond basic qualification statements."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions several strengths but does not distill them into a clear overall pitch."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Conveys a recognizable strengths profile that fits the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Combines a few reinforcing strengths into a persuasive case for why this candidate fits especially well."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Leaves a sharp, memorable impression of a differentiated candidate whose strengths align unusually well with the role."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The cleanliness and polish of the prose at the level of spelling, grammar, and sentence control.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, typing, or grammar problems noticeably undermine credibility or readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Multiple visible errors or awkward constructions reduce polish, though the meaning stays understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Writing is generally clear with only occasional errors or rough phrasing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Prose is polished and easy to read, with at most rare minor mechanical issues."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Writing is exceptionally clean, controlled, and professional, with no meaningful mechanical distractions."}]}]}
